text: This is the video I think every creator is a little scared to make. The one where I actually ask you for something. So I'll be straight. I want you to become a paid member. Here's why, and here's what you can get. Many of you probably know that content creation is still a hobby for me. A serious hobby, but still not the thing that pays my bills. I currently have a full-time job and I work in investment finance. But at some point, and honestly, the sooner the better, I do want to switch to content creation full-time. The problem is that for this to happen, the channel needs a more stable income stream. And right now, it doesn't really have one. Despite having around 1 million views per day on TikTok, many of my videos still receive around 10 cents per thousand eligible views. And since only around every third view actually counts as eligible, the real RPM is basically pennies. Instagram doesn't pay me at all, and my YouTube is still very small. So one obvious option would be ads and commercial. And I already get offers for that from time to time. But honestly, even though never say never, I would prefer to keep that as a last resort. I would rather try to make this channel sustainable with the support of the people who actually watch it. And this brings me to paid membership. The plan is to use paid membership for the content that I still want to make, but that no longer gets the same exposure on my main page. Dating advice, relationship content, self-improvement, mansplaining feminism, educational videos, more personal thoughts, more direct interaction. Because right now, a lot of new people are coming to my channel for debates, debunking viral claims, and political videos. And that is fine. I enjoy making those too. But I do not want the other side of the channel to slowly disappear just because the algorithm doesn't push it as much. Even my last mansplaining feminism video didn't reach 100k views, which is a bit sad. So instead of forcing all of this content onto the main page or stopping to film it altogether, I want to create a separate space for people who actually want it. So what can you get as a paid member if you reach the first goal? First, at least two exclusive videos per week. Second, priority DMs. Third, access to a special members chat where we can build a small community around this channel. Not just random comments on the viral videos, but an actual community of curious critical thinking people interested in self-improvement. But for this to make sense, we do need to reach the first goal, since I do need some critical mass. So here's the deal. If we get 200 paid members by the end of this month, July 2026, I will commit to making at least two exclusive videos per week for paid members. And then we can develop it further. Could be even more videos, could be even more interaction, maybe live streams, maybe topic requests, maybe some other perks. But if that doesn't happen, then I'll have to look at other ways to monetize. Maybe focus more on YouTube, maybe start accepting ads, maybe something else. But before I go that route, I want to try this first. I want to see whether this channel can be supported by the people who actually watch it. So yes, every membership would genuinely matter. If you want to support the channel, and if you want more dating, relationship, self-improvement, and educational content, become a paid member. Let's see if we can make this work.
